quest.title: Whisper Beneath the Waves
quest.description: You discover a strange tree at the Eye of Kratti...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: East of the Moon, West of the Sun

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: Fishing. Though so far, I've only caught things that aren't fish.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: If it were knick-knacks from shipwrecks, that'd be fine, 'cause traveling merchants would buy those. I once pulled up a boot with half a... *sigh* Forget it. Talking about stuff like that will scare the fish off.

choices.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: Treasure hunting, huh? That "Great Treasure" they say lies east of the moon and west of the sun... Doesn't take much to know this isn't the place to find it.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: Though saying that, there've been a good few shipwrecks in these waters. There may well be treasure beneath the waves, not that you'd find it easy to get at.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: I heard talk at the tavern, too, from sailors who escaped their sinking ship. Said it happened on a moonless night, yet something was glowing among the towering waves.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: They swore it was one-eyed Kratti, a monster that could swallow the moon. It was fighting a giant sea serpent for the right to rule its territory.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: For a long time after that, this whole stretch of ocean stayed as dark as ink. No ships dared pass through — they all feared the lost souls beneath the waves would drag them down.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: People claim those lost souls still wander nearby, but I say it's all just stories meant to frighten kids. I don't buy that nonsense.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: It's cursed. There used to be a whirlpool here — the sailors called it the Eye of Kratti. Then one day, this tree just started growing right out of it.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: And that wasn't the only strange thing that happened around that time. Tracing it back, it all started with those rocks falling from the sky... Who knows? Maybe this tree's from the same place.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: Then there are those little shiny things that appear every now and then, rare as you like, those are. I figured there might be new kinds of fish, too. That's why I came out here — to try my luck.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: I used to have a fishing buddy who came out here, too, but he said he kept hearing strange singing. It spooked him so bad, he never came back. Hah, only half a Frostmoon Scion that one, but he inherited every one of their odd little habits.

response.speaker: Ilmari
response.text: No worries. There's not a single fish in sight anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you feel okay? Paimon's getting a little dizzy over here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Paimon thinks she just heard someone talking...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... There's a bunch of those shiny little things we saw earlier! Wait, where are we, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be we've circled round to right under that weird tree? And those green things... what even are they?

talks.objective: Find a way to collect Kuuvahki Dewdrops and throw them into the central energy field

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: Did you see that? The tree just lit up all of a sudden, and these little things... Too bad they're not fish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that thing in the center must be its root, huh? Paimon doesn't understand how it works, but now that it's all shiny, it looks way better than when it was dull.

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: It's pretty hard to believe... But you've got no reason to spin me a yarn. Looks like that fishing buddy of mine, that half-Frostmoon Scion, was right after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: But so what? They're just remnants of the past. Whatever they sing or say, it's not gonna stop us living folks from catching living fish.

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: Anyway, you folks are treasure hunters, aren't you? That thing you picked up earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the <color=#00E1FFFF>Proof of the Cognoscenti</color>? It looks like an ordinary feather...

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: A trader I know once said that if you collect five <color=#00E1FFFF>Proofs of the Cognoscenti</color>, you'll uncover that "Great Treasure" east of the moon and west of the sun. Who knows if it's true?

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: Still, a lot of treasure hunters seem to believe the stories. They're all rushing after it like crazy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's treasure, after all! If you ask Paimon, she's kinda curious too.

dialogues.speaker: Ilmari
dialogues.text: If I were 20 years younger... Nah, even then, I'd still be out here fishing. That said, another day, another empty bucket...
